caption: The drawing features a single object placed in the center of the composition. The object appears to be a vessel composed of two main conical sections stacked vertically, with the top section slightly narrower and rounded, and the bottom section wider. A curved handle connects the two sections on the left side. The surface of the object has a metallic appearance, rendered in shades of green, brown, and gray, with lighter and darker areas indicating reflections and shadows. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the entire composition is set within a faint rectangular border. There are small brownish stains and discolorations along the edges of the paper.
title: Lamp
